erase.heading: Erase personal data
erase.description: For a diver who asks you to delete what you hold about them. This is not the same as removing them — it destroys their details for good.
erase.destroyedNote: Destroyed: their name, email, phone, date of birth, emergency contact, insurance, card numbers and card photos, medical answers, rental sizes, notes about them, review comments, and any photos they shared.
erase.keptNote: Kept: that they signed your release, which version they signed, and when — plus the trips they were on and what was paid, with their name gone from all of it. Your signed releases stay verifiable.
erase.noUndoNote: There is no undo, and no way to get any of it back. Removing them first is the reversible option.

rentalFit.cantFillBody: Flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in. Their count stays on the packing list but the size comes off, so nobody lays out a size the shop is short of.
rentalFit.fitResolved: Fit resolved — pack their sizes again

Your note appears under them, labelled as the shop talking, so it never reads as replacing the card the desk checks.

6 open water dives
Full rental gear
Light lunch

address.description: Where a diver meets the boat or walks into the storefront.

units.description: How your crew reads depths, water temperature, and prices.

units.currencyDetail: Changing it does not convert anything: a 130 trip stays 130, it just means 130 of the new currency. Orders and payments already settled keep the currency they were charged in.

export.title: Data export
export.description: Download everything this shop keeps in DiveDay as plain CSV files — divers, cards, trips, bookings, signed waivers, rental sizes, orders, wait lists, dive sites, and courses. Yours to keep, whenever you want it — including a ready-to-import contacts file another system's import wizard can map directly.

downloadButton.acknowledged: On its way — check your downloads

bundle.heading: What's in the bundle
bundle.description: One ZIP with a README and a CSV for each kind of record. Every date and time carries its timezone, money is in cents, and your archived history comes along too — nothing is lost if you ever move on.

notIncluded.label: Not included, on purpose:
notIncluded.text: offline manifest copies, staff notes, notification logs, Stripe checkout attempts (see bookings and orders for outcomes), and unstored pasted image URLs. DiveDay's own photos export as real files in <mono>photos/</mono>. Sign-in credentials, calendar-subscription links, and your connected WhatsApp account never export — see the README.

contact.detail: Imported as given. A row with an email matches an existing diver on re-import; without one, it's always a new record.

emergencyContact.detail: Name and phone carry over when present.

diveInsurance.detail: Carried across as free text, exactly as your file holds it. Never a gate — just detail the crew wants on hand.

rentalSizes.detail: BCD, wetsuit, boot, and fin sizes become a rental-fit profile.

certificationCard.detail: Imported verified and flagged imported, refresher date included — staff give it a one-tap confirm; unrecognized levels need manual entry.

specialtyCards.detail: Imported as verified specialty cards, flagged imported; each one still needs a staff confirm before the dive that requires it.

nitrox.detail: Imported as a verified nitrox card, flagged imported — but a diver gets plain air until staff confirm it; boarding never waits.

signedWaivers.detail: A row marked already-accepted is trusted, medical clearance included, and marked imported — individual medical answers are never reconstructed, only the outcome.

waiverDocuments.detail: Fetched once from your file's URL and re-stored in DiveDay's own storage for audit. Images and PDFs up to 5 MB.

role.detail: Everyone imports as a diver. Staff roles and logins are never granted by import.

cardOnFile.detail: Stays with your payment processor — DiveDay never imports card or payment data.

pastVisits.detail: One row per booking becomes visit history — not a dive, and it never appears on your schedule or counts toward capacity.

receiptsService.detail: Payment records stay with your processor; gear-service history has nowhere to land — DiveDay tracks sizes, not individual rigs.

issues.emailInvalid: Email "{email}" doesn't look valid — imported without an email.
issues.expiryUnreadable: Refresher-due date "{value}" can't be read as a date — the card imports for staff review instead of as verified, so nobody boards on a date we guessed.
issues.expiryAssumedMonthFirst: Refresher-due date "{value}" read as {parsed} (month first). Check it if your file writes day first.
issues.cardMarkedUnverified: Your file marks this card "{status}" — imported for staff review rather than as verified, since your own records don't call it checked.
issues.specialtyNotGated: Specialty "{specialty}" isn't a specialty we gate on (deep, wreck, night, drysuit) — nothing imported for it.
issues.specialtyNoCardNumber: Specialty "{specialty}" has no card number on the row — not imported. A card without a number can't be verified.
issues.specialtyImportedVerified: {count, plural, one {Specialty card} other {# specialty cards}} imported as verified from your records — flagged imported. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they've seen the card.
issues.specialtyImportedPending: {count, plural, one {Specialty card} other {# specialty cards}} imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.levelNamesSpecialty: Certification "{level}" names a specialty, not a level, and this row's specialty column was used instead — no level card imported. Add that card by hand if it's a separate one.
issues.levelIsTechnical: Certification "{level}" is a technical or overhead-environment rating, not a rung on the recreational ladder — not imported, and never read as a nearby level. DiveDay doesn't gate on these; record it by hand if your shop does.
issues.levelNotGated: Certification "{level}" isn't a level we gate on — card not imported. Add it by hand if it's a real card.
issues.levelNoCardNumber: Certification level "{level}" has no usable card number — card not imported. A card without a number can't be verified.
issues.certImportedVerified: Card imported as verified from your records — flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm for staff.
issues.certImportedPending: Card imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.nitroxImported: Nitrox card imported as verified from your records — flagged imported. Fills give plain air until a staffer taps confirm.
issues.nitroxNoCardNumber: Nitrox marked on the source with no card number — add and verify a nitrox card in DiveDay.
issues.waiverDateInvalid: Waiver accepted date "{value}" isn't a real calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD) — imported dated to today instead.
issues.waiverImported: Waiver imported as accepted — trusted from the prior shop, including medical clearance, and marked “imported” so it's never confused with a release signed in DiveDay.
issues.dobInvalid: Date of birth "{value}" isn't a plausible calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD, 1900 or later, not in the future) — imported without it.
issues.visitDateUnreadable: Visit date "{value}" isn't a date we can read — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.visitNoReference: Visit imported without a booking reference — a re-import matches it on date, name, and amount, so two identical bookings on one day come in as one visit.
issues.visitNoDate: This row names a past booking but carries no date — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.mergedDuplicate: Same diver as row {row} ({email}) — this row's cards, waiver, and past visit are added to them, contact details left as the earlier row has them.
issues.noEmailNewRecord: No email — imported as a new record; a re-import can't match it to update.

whatsapp.description: Send trip reminders and recaps from your shop's own WhatsApp number, so divers recognise who is messaging them. Without this, those courtesy texts go out as SMS from a platform number.

setup.heading: How connecting works
setup.description: You won't need to create anything in Meta's tools or copy any keys across. Everything happens in Meta's own window, and DiveDay handles the rest.
setup.step1: Press Connect. Meta opens its own window, where you sign in with the Facebook account that manages your shop.
setup.step2: Choose the phone number you want divers to hear from, or add a new one, and accept Meta's terms.
setup.step3: That's it. DiveDay registers the number and submits your message template for approval on your behalf.

test.heading: Send a test message
test.description: Saving credentials does not prove they work. Send yourself a real message to confirm the token, the template, and the language all line up before a diver depends on it.
test.phoneDescription: In full international form, starting with the country code.

disconnect.heading: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Removes your stored token and returns courtesy messages to SMS. Your WhatsApp account and templates are untouched.

backup.description: Every week, a full copy of your shop's records lands in storage you own. If you ever leave — or DiveDay ever disappears — the copy is already yours.

status.notConfiguredDescription: Point DiveDay at an S3-compatible bucket you own — AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, and friends — and a full export bundle lands there every week.

form.heading: Destination
form.description: Any S3-compatible storage works. Use a credential that can only write to this bucket — DiveDay never needs to read, list, or delete anything in it.
form.endpointHint: Your provider's S3 API origin — HTTPS, with no bucket or path in it.
form.regionHint: The signing region — “auto” on Cloudflare R2, “us-east-1” style on AWS.
form.prefixHint: Bundles land inside this folder in the bucket.
form.secretHint: Stored sealed, used only to sign uploads, and never shown again — not even to you.
form.secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current key; enter a new one only to rotate it.

how.heading: How it works
how.weekly: Once a week, DiveDay builds your full export bundle — every CSV, the README, your photos — and delivers it to your bucket. It's the same bundle as the Data export download, so what you'd take when leaving is what gets backed up.
how.contents: Your trip schedule rides along as trips.ics, readable by any calendar app.
how.sealed: The secret access key is sealed before it's stored and opened only at the moment of upload.
how.failures: A delivery that fails is recorded below and tried again on the next weekly run — DiveDay never hammers your bucket with retries.

incidentExport.title: Incident-ready export
incidentExport.ownerOnlyNotice: The incident-ready export is the shop's own account of a departure, so only an owner can produce one. Everything it draws on — the roll call, the timeline, each diver's status — is on this manifest.
incidentExport.description: One document of what was recorded for this departure — boarding, the roll-call timeline, certification evidence, and waiver status — ready to print and hand to authorities or insurers.
incidentExport.factsOnly: This document reports recorded facts with their timestamps. It does not assess, certify, or imply any safety judgment.
incidentExport.rosterDescription: Every active booking on this departure’s manifest, with the recorded result at each checkpoint. A checkpoint with no recorded result reads “Awaiting roll call” — an absence is stated, never left blank. Buddy team is the grouping staff recorded in DiveDay for this departure, not for each dive; a team has two or more members and may include a crew member, who is marked as such. A blank is not a statement that anyone dived alone — many shops record no teams at all.
incidentExport.buddyPairedByUnknown: Recorder and time not on record
incidentExport.crewNone: No crew was assigned to this departure.
incidentExport.evidenceDescription: Cards as held on the shop’s records when this document was generated, with their review dates. Waiver status only — medical questionnaire answers are never part of this document.
incidentExport.waiverCompleteAttested: Recorded by staff from an in-person signature.
incidentExport.waiverCompleteImported: Imported acceptance from a prior system — not signed through this shop’s own release.
incidentExport.waiverNotSigned: No current signed waiver on record.
incidentExport.waiverPending: A waiver link was issued and has not been signed.
incidentExport.waiverMedicalReview: Medical review flagged as required — status only; the questionnaire’s answers are not part of this document.
incidentExport.timelineDescription: Every roll-call entry recorded for this departure, oldest first, corrections included — entries are append-only, so a correction adds a line and never rewrites one.
incidentExport.timelineEmpty: No roll-call entries have been recorded for this departure.
incidentExport.footerHashExplainer: Computed from this document’s recorded facts. Generating the export again from unchanged records reproduces the same code, so two copies can be checked against each other.
